what: No-stall skip breadcrumb moved to gate wrapper stdout without orchestrator relay obligation
scenario_or_breakage: `skills/implement/SKILL.md:860` today prints `⏩ 18a: stall recovery — no stall detected` as operator-visible orchestrator text. The plan prints it only inside `--phase gate` captured Bash stdout and does not list it in the teardown-tail relay contract. Operators lose the skip breadcrumb inside collapsed tool output.
suggested_fix: Keep prompt-side skip print in `SKILL.md` when `STALL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED=false`, or add the skip line to the gate stdout relay list alongside `RENAME_*` / `ISSUE_URL`.

what: Finalize marker emission not isolated from `set -e` abort path
scenario_or_breakage: `--phase finalize` folds marker printing with closing marks and `implement-finalize teardown` under the same `set -euo pipefail` script as retirees. A failed `cat` of `summary-final.md` (mirroring `step-16-17.sh` `print_summary_markers`) can exit before token/timing marks and teardown, leaving `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR` and session pointers uncleared (#3425 violation).
suggested_fix: Wrap marker printing in `set +e` (or `cat ... || true`) and always run closing marks, `_restore_finalize`, and teardown afterward, matching `step-16-17.sh` non-aborting marker behavior.

what: Memory stall layer resolution left ambiguous vs `_stall_layer_active`
scenario_or_breakage: Plan applies `_stall_layer_active` to decide `STALL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED` but says memory comes from `step-18a-gate.sh` sources. The retiree only accepts `true|false` in `--stall-tracking-memory` (`step-18a-gate.sh:65-68`); other non-empty values silently stay `false` in the emitted KV while disk/finalize/session use broader activation. A non-canonical in-memory `STALL_TRACKING` value can be dropped and skip recovery.
suggested_fix: Pin memory resolution as: use the `--stall-tracking-memory` arg when non-empty, else `${STALL_TRACKING:-false}`, with no `true|false`-only case filter; run `_stall_layer_active` on the emitted `STALL_TRACKING_MEMORY` value.

what: `test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh` Step 18 launcher awk block must be rewritten, not only grep strings
scenario_or_breakage: The harness awk-scopes the old `python/cli.py final-report step18b` fence (`scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh:61-65`). Replacing grep pins without updating that block can leave stale launcher checks or miss wrapper `.step17-emitted` touches.
suggested_fix: When implementing, replace the awk fence selector with `step-18.sh --phase finalize` and keep the no-touch-in-SKILL-fence guard scoped to orchestrator fences only.
